name: 15658 · Ligonier, PA
findings: ZIP 15658 (Ligonier) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15658 (Ligonier) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
48% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15658 (Ligonier) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
